messages:
Carmen: Heads-up — multiple customers are hitting errors for function calls after the rwd-mati-2.0 canary (noticed ~15% rollout). Also seeing a small billing spike tied to retries. example request_id: 0x9a3c

Ben: Can you paste an example failing request/response? logs? which tool is failing?

Carmen: Repro and quick curl below. Fail happens on the payment tool path — response is a validation error from the function-call layer.
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-mati-2.0","input":"charge user","functions":[{"name":"charge_card","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"amount":{"type":"number"},"currency":{"type":"string"}}}}],"function_call":{"name":"charge_card","arguments":{"amount":"100","currency":"USD"}}}'
```

Carmen: Response snippet: `400 schema validation failed: field \"amount\" expected number got string` — upstream payment service never gets called, client retries, we see retries and billing-per-request jump.

Alice: This matches a change in the model's function-matching heuristics we saw in the canary: rwd-mati-2.0 enforces strict JSON types on function args instead of attempting simple coercion. Previously the runtime coerced strings to numbers for simple cases. Looks like the model is now rejecting/matching differently during tool choice which leads to a schema validation error before the tool is invoked.

Ben: Ok. Repro steps verified on my side. Minimal repro: send amount as string vs number; older model accepted it (coerced), new one rejects. Impact: payment flows from two customers so far.

Morgan: Rollout status: deploy-bot shows canary at 15% (started 2060012000). Recommend pausing immediately and rolling back the canary while we fix the coercion policy. Can we pause now?

DevBot: deploy-bot: canary pause initiated by @Morgan. Current canary %: 15 -> pausing.

Ben: I'm going to trigger rollback for rwd-mati-2.0 canary to last stable (rwd-mati-1.9). I'll also add a hotfix in the runtime to re-enable best-effort coercion for function args to avoid breaking customers while model teams iterate.

Alice: I'll open a model-change PR: disable strict function-type enforcement for the next patch or add an opt-in flag. Also adding unit tests for schema coercion and integration test against the payment tool.

Carmen: Notifying affected customers with temporary rollback note and asking for confirmation on impact window. Creating incident INC-20260317-42.

Morgan: Assigning tasks — Ben: rollback + runtime hotfix; Alice: model PR + tests; Carmen: customer comms + incident owner. I'll monitor metrics and confirm when error rate and billing spike subside. :eyes:

Ben: Rollback started — calling rollback API now. I'll post status when done.

DevBot: rollback job 0x7f4a queued by Ben. ETA ~2m.

Ben: Rollback completed. Canary at 0%. Error rate back to baseline, billing retries dropping. Please keep monitoring.

Carmen: Confirmed one impacted customer responded; they saw no persistent charge. Will close incident after postmortem and patch. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
